title: task-store: listReady silently swallows dangling depends_on (same stranding class as TASK-096) + goalStuck @throws JSDoc + tool-contract list_ready doc fix
description: Follow-up minted from the TASK-096 review (rev-096, APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOWUPS, 2026-07-06). L1: src/task-store.js:330 — listReady treats an unknown depends_on key as unsatisfied, so a ticket with a typo'd dep silently disappears from MCP list_ready output; this is the same silent-stranding class TASK-096 just fixed in drive-loop's depsAreDone (which now throws naming the ticket and missing dep). Align the two: throw or surface loudly. L2: src/drive-loop.js:161-173 — goalStuck's JSDoc lacks @throws even though it can propagate depsAreDone's error when called standalone with a partial list (selectNextTicket documents it). N2: skills/mcp-server/references/tool-contract.md:105 (+ .claude parity copy) says list_ready wraps listTodos while src/mcp-server.js:119 actually wraps listReady — pre-existing drift. NOT part of goal-sweep2 (unlabeled backlog; minting a reviewer follow-up does not expand the human-approved goal).
acceptance_criteria: listReady fails loudly (throw naming ticket + missing dep, mirroring TASK-096's depsAreDone contract) or explicitly surfaces dangling depends_on refs in its result, instead of silently omitting the ticket — red-first spec against the current silent behavior.
goalStuck's JSDoc documents the propagated throw (@throws) consistently with selectNextTicket's.
tool-contract.md's list_ready row (both parity copies) matches src/mcp-server.js ground truth (wraps listReady, not listTodos); the references/ parity sensor stays green.
